verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an API-first inference provider. Its documented public API offers OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Responses and speech-to-text endpoints plus the Anthropic Messages API, with Bearer/X-API-Key auth, request schemas, code examples in cURL/Python/TypeScript and an API playground. Probes confirmed a live OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and Markdown docs, all returning HTTP 200. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that API calls actually succeed in practice (the probes only verify the documentation artifacts exist).
